disclaimer: Synthetic simulation data for a proof of concept. Parameters are simulation assumptions, NOT measured Kenyan MSME statistics, and results do not establish generalisation to real businesses.
assumptions: Daily revenue follows a log-normal multiplicative noise model with per-archetype coefficient of variation.
Zero/low-revenue and unusually-high-revenue days are explicit Bernoulli events with per-archetype probabilities.
Weekly and monthly seasonality are multiplicative profiles.
Transaction counts are Poisson with mean revenue / average transaction value; per-transaction amounts are log-normal and rescaled so each day's transactions sum to that day's revenue.
